description: The CAD 49 welfare follow-on is the closest existing offer to fulfillment. Its bilingual notice-only rehearsal passed offline, and excerpt handling already has an assigned mission. This turn checks the remaining operational question against the public contract and pinned source: how the official notice can be supplied to an authorized private case. A documented input mechanism would support a later case-level check. Actual inclusion, execution and recipient delivery each require their own evidence. Five feedback sources remain unclassified, so eligible demand is unknown. The order register is unavailable, verified available funds are CAD 0, and no revenue is verified.
